digest.component_or_area: LLM provider-qualifier decider in config resolution
propositions: The provider qualifier should be decided by membership in a known-provider registry (a KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES frozenset) rather than by a prefix-shape regex, so an unknown configured provider is rejected while a colon-bearing model id stays intact.

A typo'd configured provider such as bedrok is currently accepted at config resolution and only fails much later at provider construction; membership validation makes _resolve_target raise LLMConfigError naming the value and listing valid ones.
An unknown inline prefix must NOT raise and must fall back to unqualified so dotted Bedrock ids whose pre-colon prefix is not a provider name are not discarded.
Dropping test and google_genai from the set changes infer_provider to return None for FunctionModel doubles, requiring the usage-log provider assertions to change from 'test' to None.
Slashed provider names like gateway/openai were wrongly rejected by the shape regex and should split correctly under membership.
The static provider-name set can drift from the runtime pydantic-ai registries, so a drift test must assert runtime provider names are a subset of KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES.
